why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: Install the Zoi app from the App Store or Google Play . The seller in both stores is Zoi Labs LLC. Warning Zoi's site also offers a direct Android APK "for people who cannot use Google Play". Use the store versions. A fake APK passed around in chats is an easy way to lose a phone's data or a wallet.
Sign in with Google, with Apple on an iPhone, or with a code sent to your email. If a friend gave you an invite code, enter it for the one-time 20 ZOI. You don't need anyone's code to join.
Do the face check when the app asks. "No ID document is needed to sync. Sync only asks for a quick face check that runs on your phone, to confirm a real person is behind the account."
Tap Sync each time the four-hour window opens, up to six times a day, and at least once a day to build the streak.
Open the Welcome chest in the app and finish its tasks within 7 days for 100 ZOI.
Later, sending ZOI will need a one-time check "with an ID document and a face check, by a verification provider". Zoi targets that for the first half of 2027 and says it will be free.
